notes: Stories created for EVAL-CT-M3 with full coverage: schema, logic, API, tests, integration.

change_log.value: Added schema/contract story for relevance scoring
Added core logic story for condition + eligibility matching
Added unit and edge case testing story

EVAL-CT-M3-S1.title: Define Relevance Scoring Schema and Contract
EVAL-CT-M3-S1.description: Define a structured schema for trial relevance including condition match score, eligibility match score, and overall relevance score. Extend or align with existing clinical_trials_models.py Pydantic models.

EVAL-CT-M3-S2.title: Implement Condition and Eligibility Matching Logic
EVAL-CT-M3-S2.description: Build core logic to compare user query intent against trial condition fields and eligibility criteria text. Include normalization (synonyms, case handling) and scoring heuristics.

EVAL-CT-M3-S3.title: Expose Relevance Scores via Evaluate Care Facade
EVAL-CT-M3-S3.description: Integrate relevance scoring into evaluate_care_facade so that trial results include relevance metrics for downstream UI and LLM response generation.

EVAL-CT-M3-S4.title: Unit Tests for Relevance Matching and Scoring
EVAL-CT-M3-S4.description: Create unit tests covering condition matching accuracy, eligibility parsing, edge cases (missing criteria, vague queries), and scoring consistency.
EVAL-CT-M3-S4.evidence: GAP: No existing tests for clinical trial relevance scoring; must be created in backend/tests/

EVAL-CT-M3-S5.title: Integrate Relevance Scoring into Clinical Trials Service Pipeline
EVAL-CT-M3-S5.description: Embed relevance scoring into the clinical_trials_service workflow after trial retrieval, ensuring all returned trials are annotated with relevance before formatting.

EVAL-CT-M3.mitigation: Use deterministic keyword and normalization heuristics to avoid reliance on external models.
